units.source_text: 黄昏时分，室中幽暗，但见诸侍女等一律穿着便衣，面目难于分辨。

en.t: At twilight, the room was dim, and the waiting women, all dressed in everyday clothes, were hard to tell apart.

units.source_text: 源氏叫玉鬘：“稍稍坐近外边些。”

en.t: Genji called to Tamakazura, "Sit a little closer to the outside."

units.source_text: 低声对她说道：“弁少将和藤侍从跟着我来了。

en.t: He said to her in a low voice, "Ben no Shosho and To no Jiju have come along with me.

units.source_text: 他们恨不得早就飞了过来，但夕雾中将太老实，一直不带他们来，也太不体谅人了。

en.t: They would have flown here long ago if they could, but Yugiri, being far too earnest, never brought them, which was really inconsiderate of him.
All these men are in love with you.

units.source_text: 即使是寻常人家的女子，当她们养在深闺内时，也按照其身份之高下，而为各种各样的人所恋慕。

en.t: Even daughters of ordinary families, when they are raised deep within the women's quarters, are admired by all sorts of men according to their rank.

units.source_text: 何况我家，内部虽然乱七八糟，外面看来比实际体面得多。

en.t: How much more so in my household, which, though it is a disorderly place inside, looks far more respectable from the outside than it really is.

units.source_text: 我家虽然已有许多女子，但都不是他们所可恋慕的。

en.t: Although there are already many women in my house, none of them is someone these men could properly set their hearts on.

units.source_text: 自从你来了之后，我在寂寞无聊之时，常想看看恋慕者用心的深浅。

en.t: Ever since you came, when I have felt lonely and bored, I have often wanted to see how deep the devotion of your admirers might be.

units.source_text: 现在果然符合我的本意了。

en.t: Now things have turned out just as I hoped.
" His voice as he said this was very soft.
